mentions.name: Research Session Tracker (Chrome extension)
mentions.description: A Chrome extension for tracking research progress across browsing sessions. Users name a research session, and the extension keeps track of which tabs were opened and which have been read or not read. Resuming a session reopens all the previously saved tabs so the user can continue where they left off.
mentions.source_excerpt:
A Chrome extension to track your research progress.

You give a title to your research session, and it keeps track of which tabs you have opened, which ones you have read and have not read.
